address: 8 Market Square, Westerham, TN16 1AW, United Kingdom
bio: The friendly and enthusiastic team do a wonderful job of making your visit to this well-run, elegant-looking village restaurant a memorable experience. The charming, attentive service plays its part, as do the beautifully presented modern dishes. The technically accomplished cooking is underpinned by the chef's sourcing of prime British ingredients, shown off in dishes like Hereford beef with carrots and whiskey or the signature almond soufflé with Kentish honey. Housed in a former bank, you can visit the old vaults to sample wines suggested by the sommelier....
